attributes.text: Why not just use a timer?
attributes.originalText: Why not just use a timer?

attributes.text: A timer limits how long you use an app. AwayDoomscrollin' takes a different approach: it blocks supported feeds and short-video loops while keeping purposeful use available.
attributes.originalText: A timer limits how long you use an app. AwayDoomscrollin' takes a different approach: it blocks supported feeds and short-video loops while keeping purposeful use available.

attributes.text: Messages, search and YouTube long videos remain available. Choose Strict or Balanced for Instagram and YouTube; Stories and selected short videos depend on your mode.

attributes.text: Hi, I'm the independent developer behind Resolve Community and AwayDoomscrollin'.
attributes.originalText: Hi, I'm the independent developer behind Resolve Community and AwayDoomscrollin'.

attributes.text: During the COVID-19 pandemic, I started spending almost all day on my computer or phone. Life outside felt complicated. Gaming or scrolling for hours felt easier and safer than socializing. Looking back, I think I was trying to escape real life.
